description: This file defines the EmployeePictureController class responsible for handling employee picture requests, including retrieving employee photos or default images, setting response headers, and managing cache validation.

classes.name: EmployeePictureController
classes.description: Controller for handling employee picture retrieval and response management, including ETag support and default image fallback.

methods.name: getEmployeePictureService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmployeePictureService instance used for fetching employee pictures and related data.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method to handle HTTP requests for employee pictures, managing ETag validation, image retrieval, and fallback to default image.

methods.name: setCommonHeaders
methods.description: Sets common HTTP headers for the response, including Content-Type, cache control, and privacy headers.
